# Third-party scripts

Bundled into the app for math and diagram blocks, which render in a
sandbox with no network. Both come from npm, checked against the
registry's integrity hash, and are MIT licensed (LICENSE beside each).

| Package | Version | File | Integrity of the npm tarball |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [katex](https://katex.org) | 0.19.0 | `dist/katex.min.js` | `sha512-v6Tznz3zJ7u3niRCoDTsumM2+HA2XXcCu+WAacCeHD2z3p9A9Ks987o5FzfTGBN0e8A0vjEgIDvLbICrXpdw/Q==` |
| [pele](https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele) | 1.12.0 | `dist/pele.js` | `sha512-3OdOK6rvkaTB569R4/I8U0H82MqPRxj7vfkbowa2rRhgSBPFhvWlfFy5eae0jP+2A6hE8abE17nsdyxJz2VBiQ==` |
